sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_profiles" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT NOT NULL, "birth_date" INTEGER NULL, "sex" TEXT NULL, "height_cm" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 1), CHECK (height_cm BETWEEN 50 AND 272));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "body_measurements" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "body_fat_percentage" REAL NULL, "neck" REAL NULL, "shoulders" REAL NULL, "chest" REAL NULL, "left_arm" REAL NULL, "right_arm" REAL NULL, "left_forearm" REAL NULL, "right_forearm" REAL NULL, "waist" REAL NULL, "abdomen" REAL NULL, "hips" REAL NULL, "left_thigh" REAL NULL, "right_thigh" REAL NULL, "left_calf" REAL NULL, "right_calf" REAL NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, CHECK (weight_kg BETWEEN 20 AND 400), CHECK (body_fat_percentage IS NULL OR body_fat_percentage BETWEEN 0 AND 100));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercises" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "muscle_group" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "is_custom" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_custom" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_plans" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_plan_exercises" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "workout_plan_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_plans (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "rest_seconds" INTEGER NULL, CHECK (rest_seconds IS NULL OR rest_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 3600));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_plan_sets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "plan_exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_plan_exercises (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "repetitions" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, CHECK (repetitions >= 0), CHECK (weight_kg >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sessions" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "workout_plan_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES workout_plans (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "plan_name_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "finished_at" INTEGER NULL, "duration_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK (duration_seconds IS NULL OR duration_seconds >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_session_exercises" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "plan_exercise_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES workout_plan_exercises (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "exercise_name_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "muscle_group_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "rest_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "skipped" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("skipped" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_session_sets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_session_exercises (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "planned_repetitions" INTEGER NULL, "planned_weight_kg" REAL NULL, "repetitions" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("completed" IN (0, 1)), "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, CHECK (repetitions >= 0), CHECK (weight_kg >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "theme_preference" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system', "auto_start_timer" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("auto_start_timer" IN (0, 1)), "timer_sound" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("timer_sound" IN (0, 1)), "timer_vibration" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("timer_vibration" IN (0, 1)), "default_rest_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 90, "weight_increment_kg" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 2.5, "weight_unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'kg', PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 1), CHECK (default_rest_seconds BETWEEN 5 AND 3600), CHECK (weight_increment_kg BETWEEN 0.25 AND 50));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "timer_states" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "started_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "elapsed_before_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 1));
CREATE INDEX idx_body_measurements_date ON body_measurements (date)

CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_plan ON workout_sessions (workout_plan_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_started_at ON workout_sessions (started_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_status ON workout_sessions (status)
CREATE INDEX idx_session_exercises_session ON workout_session_exercises (session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_session_exercises_exercise ON workout_session_exercises (exercise_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_session_sets_session_exercise ON workout_session_sets (session_exercise_id)
